MVP Colony is one of Visakhapatnam's most established residential neighbourhoods, with many apartments and family homes ready for a modern makeover. Our studio in Vishalakshi Nagar is close by, so site visits, material selection and meetings are easy.

We design apartment interiors that make every square foot count, with clever storage, light-filled layouts and Vastu built in.

Popular MVP Colony projects

  • 2 and 3 BHK apartment interiors
  • Renovation of older apartments
  • Modular kitchens and wardrobes
  • Living and dining makeovers
  • Moisture-resistant materials for the coast
  • 3D designs before work begins
